hero.body: Pegasus TCG is a space for collectors, players, and card enthusiasts to discover, buy, sell, and track the value of their favorite cards on a secure, convenient, and transparent platform
hero.title: Growing Together with the TCG Community

story.imageAlt: Illustration of the Pegasus team in an ancient Greek setting
story.p1: Pegasus TCG began with a group of card enthusiasts trading cards at weekend tournaments. We experienced difficulties buying and selling, including fragmented marketplaces, inconsistent grading standards, and unclear pricing
story.p2: So we created Pegasus with the goal of making the hobby we love more transparent and trustworthy. Our goal is simple: to build the platform we wish we'd had when we started collecting cards, and a place where the collector community can grow together
story.title: Our Story

apirak.bio: Can delete a thousand lines of code in the blink of an eye. Usually asks for five more minutes of sleep before heading into battle, but if a fair maiden is leading the charge, even a Pegasus would ask him to slow down

arlif.bio: Knows every nook and cranny of the infrastructure, but whenever the system goes down, rushes over with a shocked look and asks, “Huh, who did this? It was working just a second ago”

team.body: Meet the team behind the Pegasus army, working together to make the card-collecting experience even better

chanasorn.bio: Can explain complex topics well enough to get the whole room nodding along, even if some still don't understand. In his free time, he likes to show off his knowledge and good looks

gritsada.bio: They say his smile has stopped three wars. Fans lined up until the palace had to launch a booking system, while he insists, “They only came to see the guards!”

krittatee.bio: Intercepts intruders before anyone else, unfazed even by legendary bugs. But on quiet nights, often sits gazing at the sea and wonders, “Has he eaten yet?”

thanapat.bio: His eyes are sharp enough to spot a beautiful woman across the sea, but ask if his Sprint work is done and he immediately reaches for the binoculars

team.title: Meet the team

torntun.bio: Whether someone asks or no one else is willing to do it, the work always ends up in his hands. Even Jira knows who to send an unassigned Ticket to

wichapon.bio: Plans ten moves ahead, so meticulous even the gods ask to see his slides—but the moment he hears his wife call, he turns around and pretends to read Jira
